quarterly_data.signal: Management's analysis, first half (semi-annual report): with high growth still expected centred on generative AI, memory-related investment continued, centred on development. The Initial department (specialty gas supply equipment manufacturing, supply piping design and construction) performed well as capex continued at its main customers' semiconductor fabs and its cost ratio improved year on year; the Operation department (specialty gas sales management, technical services) was steady, led by facility management and semiconductor equipment maintenance, on operations at a new semiconductor fab started in fiscal 2024 and continued high production at its main customers' fabs.
